text:
tessa: heads-up: onboarding quickstart hit messy SDK errors. ruby client raises RuntimeError('401'), js client returns Error with status, go returns map blob. impossible to write a single retry middleware.

arjun: can you paste minimal repro and which endpoints? auth vs rate-limit?

tessa: mostly token failures and rate limits. sometimes API returns plain text '401', other times `{\"error\":{\"message\":\"unauthorized\"}}`. rate-limit responses often lack Retry-After. snippets: 

ruby:
```ruby
begin
  client.generate(prompt)
rescue => e
  # RuntimeError('401 Unauthorized')
  report(e)
end
```

go:
```go
resp, err := client.Call(ctx, req)
if err != nil {
  // err is map[string]interface{} from http layer currently
}
```

sam: this fragments observability. proposal: agreed canonical error classes across SDKs (Redwood::AuthError / RedwoodAuthError / RedwoodAuthError in go), a short machine token `error.code` (e.g., auth.token_expired, rate.too_many_requests), and a flat `error.meta` map. keep shape shallow to avoid parsing hell.

morgan: +1. also standardize on RFC7807-ish fields (type, title, status, detail) but keep `extensions` as flat key-values (no nested objects). SDKs should hydrate exception properties: status, code, message, meta.

arjun: for retries, SDK exceptions should include `should_retry` bool and `recommended_backoff_ms` int when applicable. also expose `retry_after` if present. That lets middlewares implement jittered backoff consistently.

tessa: compatibility: we need a transition shim that maps legacy behavior to new typed errors based on status and common message patterns. optional opt-in flag first (enable_typed_errors: true) and then flip default after two minor releases with warnings.

sam: operational request: include `error_class` and `error_code` labels in outgoing telemetry and make sure SDKs tag traces with them. makes dashboards + alerts reliable.

morgan: testing plan: unit tests that fake HTTP payloads and assert proper exception types in ruby/js/go, plus a tiny sample app in quickstart showing try/catch by class and a backoff loop. I'll draft mapping table: 401->AuthError (auth.token_invalid or auth.token_expired), 403->PermissionError, 400/422->BadRequest (validation hints in meta), 429->RateLimitError (include retry_after), 502/503/504->TransientError.

arjun: edge case: client-side validation vs server 422. map 422 to BadRequest but set `is_validation_error=true` and include `field_hints` array of {field, reason}.

tessa: timeline? support tickets rising.

morgan: I'll open umbrella issue DEVEX-1402 with mapping table and assign initial SDK PRs. aim: RFC this week, shims + tests in 10 business days, opt-in beta in next minor, full default flip after two minors.

error-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1402: "sdk-error-types-and-flat-mapping" (assignee: morgan)

tessa: perfect. I'll attach repro gist and a short ruby/js/go example to DEVEX-1402. drop any must-have error codes here and I'll add them to the table.

sam: add auth.token_missing, auth.token_expired, rate.limit_exceeded, validation.missing_field, validation.invalid_format.

arjun: add infra.connection_reset as transient.

tessa: summary: agree to typed exceptions, short machine error codes, flat meta, retry metadata, compatibility shim, opt-in rollout, and sample app. thanks! :rocket:
